general_news.title: The loss of low-income diners cost McDonald’s a lot of money last quarter
general_news.summary: McDonald's experienced a significant financial setback last quarter, losing $310 million in sales from low-income diners. This decline, the first in a year for this demographic, was attributed to a failed value promotion that customers perceived as a price increase. Rival Wendy's faced similar challenges, indicating a broader trend of low-income consumers cutting back on dining due to inflation.

general_news.title: Jack in the Box Names Taylor Montgomery President in CEO Succession
general_news.summary: Jack in the Box Inc. has appointed Taylor Montgomery, formerly of Taco Bell, as President, effective September 14, 2026. This move positions Montgomery to become CEO within the next 12 months as part of a succession plan. His role will focus on driving sales growth, improving franchisee profitability, and enhancing restaurant performance across the company's 2,115 locations.

general_news.title: Peanut Butter, Chocolate and Jelly Meet in New Reese’s Puffs Cereal
general_news.summary: General Mills has launched a new limited-edition Reese's Puffs PB+J cereal, blending the signature peanut butter and chocolate flavors with strawberry jelly. This nostalgic offering follows the success of Reese's PB+J Cups and Reese's Puffs Dark Chocolate cereal. The cereal is available nationwide for a limited time and includes exclusive temporary tattoos for added nostalgia.

general_news.title: Crown Castle Draws an Upgrade With a Lower Price Target
general_news.summary: Barclays upgraded Crown Castle (CCI) to Overweight despite cutting its price target, citing disagreement with fears of satellite competition and a strong U.S. tower market. The firm projects accelerated core leasing and organic growth in site rental billings, expecting the stock to re-rate positively due to a simpler business model and attractive dividend yield.

general_news.title: Honeywell International Announces Key Leadership Changes in Automation
general_news.summary: Honeywell International has announced key leadership changes in its automation segment, effective October 1, 2026. Billal Hammoud will become President and CEO of Process Technology, and Juan Picon will succeed him as President and CEO of Building Automation. These appointments are intended to strengthen management and support long-term growth and profitability in Honeywell's core automation franchises.
